lines.t: He walked the earth in love and grace
The Word made flesh to take our place
He healed the sick, the blind could see, and cried, repent and follow me.
Yahuwah gave His Son to die, that none be lost, that life draw nigh.
No endless pain, no hopeless cries, the wicked perish, truth defy.
Plotted out, gone forever, the proud shall fall, remember never.
From dust we came, to dust return
The fire refines, the chaff shall burn
The life he gives to all who hear
Yahushua's call so strong, so clean
Come to the light, escape the night
No torment waits, just death or life
The dead know nothing, still and cold
Not tortured flames as we've been told
The wages paid for wicked ways
An end of breath, no song is heard from the grave
The lake of fire, the second death
Where Yahweh draws His gift of breath
No life in pain, no scream, no soar
The soul consumed to be no more
The early saints would never teach
A fiery hell no hand could reach
They spoke the truth with steadfast tone
The wicked fade, their breath is gone
Yahushua weeps for those astray
He calls them home, he is the way
He warns in love, turn and be wise
For sin shall burn, then flame shall burn
Blotted out, gone forever
The proud shall fall, remember never
From dust we came, to dust return
The fire it finds, the chaff shall burn
But life he gives to all who hear
Yahushua's call so strong and so clear
Come to the light, escape the night
No torment waits, just death or light
So fear the one who gives and takes
Who wakes the soul whose mercy breaks
He longs to cleanse from every sin
But those who mock won't enter in
The book is opened, hearts are weighed
The righteous rise, the lost shall fade
So choose the life He came to call
Receive His blame, surrender all
Oh, oh, oh.
